content.value_statement: Complex AI work often needs several skills, models, and quality checks. This skill helps design cascades with routing, sandbox testing, swarm coordination, and memory.
actual_capabilities: Designs sequential, parallel, conditional, codex-sandbox, multi-model, and swarm-parallel stages.
Routes work across Claude, Codex, and Gemini-style models based on task requirements.
Defines Codex sandbox loops with tests, auto-fix attempts, and escalation limits.
Adds shared memory fields for reading and writing cascade state across stages.
Produces structured cascade plans with inputs, stages, error handling, and integration settings.
Documents workflow examples for development, modernization, and bug fixing.
limitations: It provides workflow designs and examples; it does not execute cascades by itself.
Named micro-skills and model routes must exist in the user environment.
GitHub, ruv-swarm, and memory steps require separate tooling and permissions.
Auto-fix behavior still needs human review before production changes are merged.

use_cases.title: Plan development quality pipelines
use_cases.description: Create staged workflows for research, implementation, testing, review, and pull request reporting.

use_cases.title: Route work across AI models
use_cases.description: Assign large-context, search, media, rapid prototype, and reasoning tasks to suitable model routes.

use_cases.title: Design test-and-fix audits
use_cases.description: Map quality gates that run tests, attempt sandbox fixes, recheck regressions, and escalate failures.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic cascade
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cascade for my goal: [goal]. Use these micro-skills: [skills]. Include stages, inputs, outputs, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Add model routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a cascade for [project]. Route stages across Claude, Codex, and Gemini-style models based on context size, speed, search, and reasoning needs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a test-and-fix workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Codex sandbox cascade for [repository or feature]. Include test stages, auto-fix iterations, regression checks, and escalation criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Design production orchestration
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production cascade for [system]. Include swarm parallelism, shared memory, GitHub integration, model routing, quality gates, and failure recovery.

output_examples.input: Create a workflow for shipping a new API endpoint with tests and review.
output_examples.output: A staged plan covering requirements review, implementation, sandbox testing, regression checks, style review, and pull request reporting.

output_examples.input: Modernize a legacy codebase with large context analysis and parallel cleanup.
output_examples.output: A multi-model cascade that uses large-context analysis, parallel remediation tracks, sandbox validation, and final documentation.

output_examples.input: Fix a difficult bug and explain the root cause.
output_examples.output: A workflow that runs root cause analysis, selects a model path by complexity, tests the fix, and updates the issue record.

best_practices: Define clear stage inputs, outputs, and ownership before adding parallel execution.
Set explicit retry, rollback, and escalation rules for every automated fix stage.
Use memory only for necessary context and name each stored key clearly.
anti_patterns: Do not route every task to the same model when stages have different needs.
Do not enable auto-fix loops without tests, iteration limits, and human review.
Do not reference micro-skills, MCP tools, or GitHub actions that are unavailable.

faq.question: Does this skill execute workflows automatically?
faq.answer: No. It designs cascade definitions and coordination plans that require compatible tools to run.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it coordinate multiple AI models?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes routing stages to Claude, Codex, and Gemini-style capabilities by task need.

faq.question: Can it help with automated testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Codex sandbox iteration patterns for tests, fixes, retries, and escalation.

faq.question: Does it require ruv-swarm?
faq.answer: Only swarm-parallel patterns require ruv-swarm or a similar coordination layer.

faq.question: Is this suitable for production changes?
faq.answer: Use it for planning production workflows, but review generated fixes and integration settings before merging.
